about: Data of engine E2 (assets/learn/components/engine-e2.js): the Plains Grid of Learn's regional scale (S2), used by the Grid Room (SB2) and capstone C2 (wave W4, 2026-11-05). The Plains Grid, its three zones, its plants, its links and every size, cost and outage rate are fictional and illustrative. Hourly demand, wind and solar follow the real 2025 shapes of the Southwest Power Pool grid (town_year.json, EIA-930), scaled per zone; wind and solar per MW use LX.townProfile with EIA's 2025 monthly capacity factors (cf_targets.json). The three zones share one weather: real zones' wind and sun would not move together hour by hour. A second weather year (2024, m03-capacity-expansion-2024.json, 29 February left out) is scaled to 2025's yearly demand energy and used only for the checks. The precomputed block is written by node _tests/learn/test_e2-engine.js --write and re-solved by the same test.
